text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! It's still bright and sunny over here,
so why?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I walk into the training room to find an

irritated-looking El Condor Pasa.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Here I was thinkin' my papa was going to

compliment me for getting my lap time
down...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But he fell asleep 'cause of the time
difference!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Stupid time difference... I oughtta give it
a
German suplex!
